Usage drawn on a creature

Upon close inspection, this rune comprises hundreds of smaller characters of various runic languages. When you etch or trace this rune, choose one language you know. The rune-bearer can speak and understand the chosen language and gains a +1 status bonus to Society checks and to Lore checks related to writing (such as Library Lore and Scribing Lore).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-runesmith-assistant.pf2e-runesmith-assistant-items.Item.mG4CquA9gYJMEnbJ]{Effect: Tilus, Rune of Vocabulary}

Invocation The rune-bearer's voice rings clear and true, allowing them to automatically succeed at any flat check that could disrupt an auditory action (such as the one imposed by the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} condition) for 1 round. During this time, the bearer can also speak their true mind even if they are currently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, controlled, or otherwise unable to speak.

Level (9th) The bonus increases to +2.

Level (17th) The bonus increases to +3.
